sentences.text: Dolichochampsa was an extinct genus of eusuchian crocodylomorph and stands alone as the only member of its family, Dolichochampsidae.
This animal possessed a distinctive slender snout.
Fossils of Dolichochampsa have been found in the Yacoraite Formation of Argentina and the El Molino Formation of Bolivia.
Dolichochampsa belongs to the parent group Gavialoidea.
The type species of the genus Dolichochampsa is Dolichochampsa minima.
The relationships of Dolichochampsa with other eusuchians remain unknown due to fragmentary fossil material.
Dolichochampsa lived during the Maastrichtian stage, between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
